selection: One trained checkpoint per arm, epoch >=1, maximizing .5 original Val overall + .5 mean five noisy Val overall, tie original Val. Report epoch zero separately, never conceal regression by replacing all candidates with the fallback.
scope: Fixed recording arrangement, 0/1/2 target categories; no triple work, resplit, source removal or new physical data files.
paired_views: Two independently sampled AWGN conditions per same formal Train waveform. Both preserve identical source mixture, envelopes, gains and Bellhop. Average losses within each parent, with original row budgets. Use formal stored audio directly; unlike earlier training_views, do not apply condition-dependent Single envelopes. This common protocol change is shared by all four arms.
frozen: Entire neural acoustic encoder/projection/DEMON and running statistics; scattering/TabM/residual gate; selected waveform frontend. Frozen evidence computed once and shared across arms.
trainable: Existing count head, member integration, quantity correction and common training-only semantic classifier; E1/2/3 semantic mapper, environment encoder and decoder; E2/3 environment predictors.
guard_definition: Weakest present vs strongest absent marginal log odds (E: minus strongest presence). Reference is the less-noisy view, ties view a; enable only when its training-only semantic seven-set argmax equals the parent label and margin>0. Stop reference gradient, cap at2, tolerance.25; do not use oracle count routing.
interpretation: A method screen of task-preserving refinement, not an established innovation. Environment labels are appended-noise conditions; original recordings contain natural noise. No labels, clean reference, environment condition or source audio is used at inference. Seed13 only, no parameter sweep.
